names.en: Gu Yue Qing Shu and Gu Yue Yao Hong against Bai Ning Bing

summary.text: A Gu Yue clan elder, Gu Yue Qing Shu and Gu Yue Yao Hong surround Bai Ning Bing on the Qing Mao Mountain path the moment he breaks free of the ice crystal that ended his fight with Fang Yuan.

claims.text: When Bai Ning Bing breaks the ice crystal that sealed him after his fight with Fang Yuan, a Gu Yue clan elder, Gu Yue Qing Shu, Gu Yue Yao Hong and two more of Qing Shu’s group surround him on the mountain path, while Gu Yue Fang Zheng keeps watch from a slope above. The elder accuses him of killing Gu Yue clan Gu Masters and breaking the three-clan alliance; Bai Ning Bing releases the primeval essence he had suppressed to rank two, restoring the Northern Dark Ice Soul physique’s white silver essence to his aperture.

The elder’s rank three moonblade shatters against Bai Ning Bing’s ice blade, and his Steel Shirt Gu holds against Bai Ning Bing’s ice blade storm but not against the blade itself, which kills him. That storm, spun several times faster than Bai Ning Bing’s earlier casts, is what empties this stretch of the mountain path: it kills two of Qing Shu’s rank two Gu Masters and cuts Yao Hong to pieces, and Qing Shu’s Green Vine Gu reaches for her and fails to pull her clear.
Bai Ning Bing demands Qing Shu give up Fang Yuan’s direction in exchange for a peaceful death; Qing Shu answers by blocking his path to Fang Zheng and committing Wood Charm Gu.

Qing Shu commits without restraint to Wood Charm Gu, taking a tree spirit’s form that draws on the mountain path’s own natural essence and, narration says, amplifies his Green Vine Gu and Pin Needle Gu beyond an ordinary rank three Gu Master’s reach. Bai Ning Bing commits Icicle Gu, a reformed ice blade storm, and Blue Bird Ice Coffin Gu, whose ice crystal traps Qing Shu but cannot hold against his tree-spirit strength; both fighters spend primeval essence as though it were unlimited, wrecking the surrounding mountain path.

The same uncontrolled Wood Charm Gu that grows Qing Shu’s ruined hands into a wooden cage around Bai Ning Bing also corrodes his own body, spreading to his organs and his mind, and he can no longer tell friend from foe. Bai Ning Bing is left trapped inside that cage.

Bai clan Gu Masters fell Qing Shu’s mindless tree-spirit body, split the wooden cage open, and save Bai Ning Bing, who has fainted after the loss of his right arm. Qing Shu is dead; Gu Yue Gu Masters carry his corpse and Gu worms back to the clan. Reinforcements from both clans reach the mountain path, and the two sides retreat from the battlefield in mutual caution rather than fight further, with the ongoing wolf tide pressuring both toward restraint. Fang Zheng’s attempt to reach Qing Shu is driven back by Pin Needle Gu, since Qing Shu’s blurred mind treats any approach as an enemy’s.

Gu Yue clan.text: Gu Yue Qing Shu Gu Yue Yao Hong

Outcome.text: Bai clan Gu Masters fell Qing Shu's mindless tree-spirit body and free Bai Ning Bing from the wooden cage he was trapped in; Qing Shu is dead and his body is carried home by the Gu Yue clan, and both clans' reinforcements retreat from the mountain path rather than fight further.
